==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Talk to the {{sic|Unlike the objective below, "the" is lowercase here}} Countess of Hakewood to travel to the settlement.
*Investigate the [[Ascalon Settlement]].
*Protect the [[Ascalonian Settler|survivors]] from the waves of [[undead]]. At least one must survive.
*Defeat the [[Candy Corn Tyrant]].
*See The {{sic|Unlike the objective above, "The" is capitalized here}} Countess of Hakewood for your reward.

===Reward===
*1,000 [[Experience]]
*200 [[Gold]]
*10 [[Trick-or-Treat Bag]]s
*''In addition, each player will receive a Trick-or-Treat Bag for each settler that survives after the tyrant is defeated. They are added directly to your inventory without notification. 

==Walkthrough==
{{section-stub}} 
{{see|Mad King's Influence}}
After being teleported to the Ascalon Settlement by the Countess of Hakewood, Mad King's Influence and [[Minion Apocalypse]] will immediately be applied to all [[party]] members. Minion Apocalypse, but not Mad King's Influence, will be applied to [[animal companion]]s, [[Ascalonian Settler]]s, and quest-related foes (except [[minion]]s).

Alternatively, the first objective can be ignored by not talking to the Countess of Hakewood and walking to the Ascalon Settlement (similar to [[Evil Residents]]) instead of being teleported there. This allows some of the restrictions of Mad King's Influence to be bypassed, since that effect is not applied to all party members until a party member approaches the Ascalon Settlement. Consider waiting until Mad King's Influence is applied before using any summoning stones, since allies summoned after the application of Mad King's Influence will not be affected by that effect. Alternatively, you can enter and exit [[Nebo Terrace]] after being teleported to temporarily remove Mad King's Influence and bypass its restrictions.

== Trivia ==
* The quest name is a reference to [[w:Resident Evil Code: Veronica|Resident Evil Code: Veronica]].
** The Countess of Hakewood's line ''"Let's go wrangle us some biohazards!"'' refers to the name used for the [[w:Resident Evil|Resident Evil video game series]] in Japan, [[w:Resident Evil (1996 video game)#English localization|Bio Hazard]].
*** All non-minion foes (with the exception of Candy Corn Tyrant) have "zombie" as part of their name, which is a reference to the zombies that are featured throughout the series.
*** Candy Corn Tyrant is a reference to Tyrants that are featured as boss enemies throughout the series.
* This quest was introduced in [[Halloween 2012]].
